en.headline: Tourism Board opens International Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park from 17 September
en.dek: The free event runs to 27 September with more than 3,000 lanterns from 20 places, Nanjing Qinhuai heritage pieces including an 8-metre banyan-tree installation, and a Hong Kong lantern courtyard.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board will stage its first International Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park from 17 to 27 September, free of charge.

Organisers said the display, themed around reunion, features a World Lantern Street with more than 3,000 festive lanterns from 20 countries and regions, four large-scale Nanjing Qinhuai lantern installations created for the event — including an 8-metre banyan-tree piece inspired by Hong Kong’s signature trees — and a Hong Kong Lantern Courtyard with over 400 traditional hand-made lanterns.

Lighting runs from 6.30 pm to 11 pm daily, extended to midnight on Mid-Autumn Festival day itself on 25 September. The Board is presenting the carnival alongside the Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s Mid-Autumn lantern display at the same park.

zh.headline: 旅發局首辦國際中秋綵燈匯 9月17日起維園亮燈
zh.dek: 活動免費開放至27日，設逾3000盞來自20個國家地區綵燈、南京秦淮非遺巨型燈組包括8米榕樹，以及香港綵燈庭。
body: 香港旅遊發展局將於9月17日至27日在維多利亞公園首度舉辦「國際中秋綵燈匯」，免費入場。
局方表示，活動以「團圓」為主題，設世界綵燈大街，匯聚超過3000盞來自20個國家及地區的特色綵燈；另有南京秦淮燈彩製作團隊度身打造的四組巨型燈組，包括以香港大榕樹為靈感、高約8米的「樹影流光」，以及展示逾400盞香港傳統手工燈籠的香港綵燈庭。
亮燈時間為每日下午6時30分至晚上11時，中秋正日9月25日延長至午夜12時。綵燈匯與康樂及文化事務署同期在維園舉行的中秋綵燈會一併開放。
